content_data.project_title: Pan-European Streaming Platform Visual Identity Redesign
content_data.project_description: Comprehensive brand refresh and design system development for a major European streaming service, creating cohesive visual language across web, mobile, and connected TV platforms.
content_data.timeline: 14 months with Discovery Phase (months 1-2), Design Development (months 3-8), Implementation Support (months 9-14)
objectives: Establish unified visual identity system across 12 European markets while respecting cultural nuances
Increase brand recognition and user engagement through contemporary, accessible design language
deliverables: Comprehensive brand guidelines and visual identity manual
Color palette with accessibility compliance documentation
technical_specs: Grid system based on 8px baseline with responsive breakpoints for mobile, tablet, desktop, and TV
Color system defined in HEX, RGB, HSL with WCAG contrast ratio documentation
Typography scale using variable font technology with fallback specifications
inspiration_references: Apple TV+ minimal interface and premium content presentation
Netflix's recent interface evolution for streaming platform best practices
Contemporary Swiss design principles for typographic hierarchy
Bauhaus movement for functional minimalism and geometric clarity

memory_deletes.removed_item: Motion design timing functions and easing curves documented for development implementation
